findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: storyboard, ugc_scan · Private data: get_collection, list_brands, get_brand, check_render, ugc_scan, get_ugc_scan · Public sink: get_formula, storyboard · Destructive: get_blueprint, list_formulas, get_formula, plan_video, check_render, ugc_scan, list_channels, get_channel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: storyboard, ugc_scan · Private data: get_collection, list_brands, get_brand, check_render, ugc_scan, get_ugc_scan · Public sink: get_formula, storyboard · Destructive: get_blueprint, list_formulas, get_formula, plan_video, check_render, ugc_scan, list_channels, get_channel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_videos" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
